english.title: Failing to surrender driving licence following notice by Secretary of State
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person whose licence had been revoked by virtue of section 92(7A) of the Road Traffic Act 1988, failed without reasonable excuse to deliver the

(A)_[licence]_
(B)_[licence and its counterpart]_

to the Secretary of State forthwith
english.legislation: Contrary to section 92(7C) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) The option 'licence and its counterpart' relates to licences which came into force on or after 1st June 1990 (1st January 1991 in the case of licences granted under the law of Northern Ireland). The "counterpart" details endorsements and provisional entitlements.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, whose driving licence had been revoked by the Secretary of State, failed to deliver the

(A)_[licence]_
(B)_[licence and its counterpart]_

to the Secretary of State forthwith.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
